messages:
Tara Gomez: Hey team, first hour here. Unboxed my MBP and enrolled but System Settings shows 'Profiles: Pending' and the macOS updater fails with 'A required configuration profile is missing'. Also a FileVault prompt popped up asking for recovery key (I have nothing). Serial C02ZTR0XH7G1. Anyone available to help?

Ops (IT): Welcome Tara! :wave: DMing you in a sec. Do NOT enter any keys. Can you paste output of `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status`?

Tara Gomez: `profiles status -type enrollment` -> "Device is enrolled: Yes (MDM) - Jamf Pro - Pending configuration". `fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is Off." Update error: "A required configuration profile is missing to enable this update".

Maya - Mac Admin: Likely post-enroll profile didn't apply because device was marked staging-hold. Jamf-bot, lookup C02ZTR0XH7G1.

jamf-bot: Jamf lookup: device(C02ZTR0XH7G1) -> enrollment: pending, staging-hold: true, filevault-escrow: NOT FOUND.

Maya - Mac Admin: OK staging-hold is blocking the kernel/system profiles and FV escrow. Are you on company VPN or on office network?

Tara Gomez: Remote, on company VPN (FortiClient).

Ops (IT): Forti can break callbacks. We can either lift staging-hold for this serial and push profiles, or create a temp local admin so you can complete installs now. Which do you prefer?

Tara Gomez: Lift staging-hold please so it's fully managed. Not comfortable being admin.

Maya - Mac Admin: Doing that now and re-running post_enroll. Expect a jamf prompt in a minute.

jamf-bot: Jamf action 'lift-staging-hold' executed by Maya at 2026-11-02T09:14:12Z.

Tara Gomez: I got a prompt, ran `sudo jamf policy -trigger post_enroll` output: "Installing profile 'com.redwood.security.sys'... Success". `profiles status -type configuration` shows the security profiles and FileVault policy.

Maya - Mac Admin: Good. Run `sudo jamf policy -id 4321` to enable FileVault now if you want encryption. We'll escrow the key and revoke any temporary elevation (none granted). Reboot and re-run the macOS update.

Tara Gomez: Ran the FileVault policy, it reported encryption started and escrow recorded. Update applied after reboot. All green now, thanks for the quick help! :grin:
